description: What the desktop app's page may ask the host to do. ADR-663 D4: the page is the WEBSITE (remote), served as it is now, so this roster is the security boundary — it names exactly what the interface needs, never a default set. Nothing that acts on the member's machine may be added unless the host itself draws the consent prompt the member answers (ADR-662's local hands are bound by this). ADR-662 D14: the four hands commands are the app's own; hands_enable draws the host's consent dialog, and browser_act refuses until the member said yes there. The browser pane's window ('browser') is named in no capability, so a page loaded there can ask the host for nothing.
